To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a new automated modal analysis procedure has been developed that merges the advantages of different Operational Modal Analyses methods and is capable of giving only the real natural modes of the system.
we present an automated output only modal analysis procedure based in the merging of different operational modal analysis methods and the statistical approach.
a fully automated output only modal analysis procedure based the merging of different OMA techniques and a statistical approach is presented and all the benefits of this procedure are listed.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new automated OMA procedure based on a combination of different ODA methods.
the development of a completely automated modal analysis method that can be applied in a wide range of engineering problems.
the development of an automated procedure for the identification of modal parameters of structures based on Operational Modal Analysis.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed algorithm has shown its effectiveness in the identification of modal parameters of the structure.

a complete automated OMA method is now available, which has the potential to be used as a tool for Structural Health Monitoring, as it is capable of providing a complete set of modal parameters of the structure, without the need of any input excitation.
the presented algorithm can be applied to any kind of structure, and it has been proved to be very effective in identifying the real modal parameters of the system.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the presented algorithm is able to give as results all the modal parameters of a structure in a completely automated way, without the need for any manual intervention.
the presented algorithm is capable of identifying the modal parameters of the system in a fully automated and reliable way, with a high degree of repeatability and with a very low computational cost.
the algorithm is able to identify the real natural frequencies and damping ratios and it is able to identify a mode shape for each natural frequency.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the combination of different methods and the use of a statistical approach leads to a better identification of the modal parameters.
the proposed method has a very good performance, it is very easy to use, and the computational cost is very small.
the combination of different methods can lead to an improvement in the identification process.
